Concept.name: <concept name>

concept_ids: <concept id this question tests (at least one)>
objective_ids: <objective id that belongs to one of concept_ids>
AssessmentQuestion.type: <one of: homework | quiz | midterm | final | project | participation-prompt>

assumptions.entity: <one of: Course | Module | Concept | LearningObjective | Source | AssessmentQuestion>
assumptions.id: <a record id, or <slug>.* for a blanket policy over many records>
